tokens.name: sage-900
tokens.usage: Deepest sage. Footer ground, pressed state of primary actions, text on light sage fills.

tokens.name: sage-800
tokens.usage: Sage as TEXT or icon on light grounds (6.4:1 on bone-50). Eyebrows, links, ghost buttons.

tokens.name: sage-700
tokens.usage: Primary action fill. White text on it is 4.8:1 (AA). Do not use as text on tinted grounds below 4.5:1.

tokens.name: sage-600
tokens.usage: Logo green. Graphics, emblem, large decorative fills only: 3.5:1 on bone-50, FAILS as text and under white labels.

tokens.name: sage-500
tokens.usage: Decorative fills and chart marks. Never text.

tokens.name: sage-400
tokens.usage: Dark-theme primary fill; decorative strokes on light.

tokens.name: sage-300
tokens.usage: Dark-theme text accents; placeholder portrait tint.

tokens.name: sage-200
tokens.usage: Soft fills and dividers on light; footer secondary text on sage-900.

tokens.name: sage-100
tokens.usage: Sage card ground and hero wash.

tokens.name: sage-50
tokens.usage: Practitioners section ground.

tokens.name: bone-50
tokens.usage: Page ground in the light theme.

tokens.name: bone-100
tokens.usage: Cream card and muted surface.

tokens.name: bone-200
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers (decorative only, 1.2:1: never the sole boundary of a control).

tokens.name: bone-300
tokens.usage: Decorative hairline borders on cards. Never a control boundary (1.4:1).

tokens.name: clay-400
tokens.usage: Decorative strokes only (2.2:1 on bone-50).

tokens.name: clay-500
tokens.usage: Control borders on light grounds (3.8:1 on bone-50, 3.4:1 on sage-100). Not for text.

tokens.name: clay-600
tokens.usage: Secondary meta text on bone-50, bone-100, sage-100 and white (min 5.0:1).

tokens.name: clay-700
tokens.usage: Tertiary text and tag text on tinted fills.

tokens.name: ink-900
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy (13.3:1 on bone-50).

tokens.name: ink-700
tokens.usage: Nav links, tag text (8.2:1 on bone-50).

tokens.name: ink-600
tokens.usage: Muted body copy: min 5.0:1 on bone-50, bone-100, sage-100 and white. Replaces ink-500 for text.

tokens.name: ink-500
tokens.usage: Legacy muted ink: 4.3:1 on sage-100. Decorative or disabled use only; use ink-600 for text.

tokens.name: pure-white
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces, label text on primary fills.

tokens.name: terracotta
tokens.usage: Accent fill and large decorative marks. 3.1:1 on bone-50: never text.

tokens.name: terracotta-700
tokens.usage: Danger and urgent text and icons on light grounds.

tokens.name: honey
tokens.usage: Accent fill. 2.1:1 on bone-50: never text.

tokens.name: honey-800
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons on light grounds.

tokens.name: water
tokens.usage: Accent fill, very rare. Never text.

tokens.name: water-700
tokens.usage: Info text and icons on light grounds.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Default canvas under every section.

tokens.name: bg-elevated
tokens.usage: Raised surface: cards, inputs, dialog panel.

tokens.name: bg-muted
tokens.usage: Muted section and cream card ground.

tokens.name: bg-sage
tokens.usage: Sage-tinted section and card ground.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, bg-elevated, bg-muted and bg-sage.

tokens.name: fg-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bg, bg-elevated, bg-muted and bg-sage (min 4.5:1 on all four).

tokens.name: fg-soft
tokens.usage: Meta text (schedules, captions) on bg, bg-elevated, bg-muted and bg-sage.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Label on brand, brand-hover and brand-active fills.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary action fill (buttons, selected states). Label is on-brand.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of a primary action.

tokens.name: brand-active
tokens.usage: Pressed fill of a primary action.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Legacy name for sage as text: same as brand-text.

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Brand-colored text and icons (links, eyebrows, ghost buttons) on bg, bg-elevated and bg-sage.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Soft brand fill: selected option ground, hover wash. Text on it is fg.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairline between cards and sections. Not a control boundary.

tokens.name: border-soft
tokens.usage: Faintest divider inside a card.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Legacy decorative stroke. For controls use border-control.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Boundary of inputs, selects, radios, secondary buttons: 3:1 or more on bg, bg-elevated, bg-muted and bg-sage.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline, 3px solid, 3px offset. 3:1 or more on every surface and on the footer ground.

tokens.name: selected-border
tokens.usage: Border of a selected option. Pair with a check icon and aria-checked: never color alone.

tokens.name: focus-ring-on-dark
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline on footer-bg and any dark ground. 3:1 or more.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Dialog scrim.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icon on bg and success-bg. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Success banner ground.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icon on bg and warning-bg. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Warning banner ground.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and icon on bg and danger-bg. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Error banner ground.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Info text and icon on bg and info-bg. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Info banner ground.

tokens.name: footer-bg
tokens.usage: Footer ground.

tokens.name: footer-fg
tokens.usage: Text on footer-bg.

tokens.name: footer-fg-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and headings on footer-bg.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: One per page. Light weight allowed ONLY at 56px and up (fluid down to 3.5rem on phones). Hero is 3 to 6 words.
styles.sample: Un lugar para volver a ti

styles.name: display-h1
styles.usage: Page title (the single h1 when no hero). 56px and up for weight 300; fluid to 2.5rem.

styles.name: display-h3
styles.usage: Card and subsection headings (h3). Weight 500 because Cormorant is thin at 28px.

styles.name: display-quote
styles.sample: La sala misma se sentía paciente

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Minor headings (h4) and dialog titles inside forms.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a hero heading. Measure 40rem max.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: All running text. 18px base so 200% zoom stays comfortable. Never below 1rem.
styles.sample: Llega como estás y quédate el tiempo que necesites

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Descriptions inside cards, helper text, error text. 15px floor for any sentence.
styles.sample: Recibirás una nota con la dirección

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta rows (day, time, duration) and legal lines. 14px floor for any text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, tags, field labels. UPPERCASE allowed, 4 words max, tracking 0.14em max. 13px floor; weight 500 so thin strokes do not vanish.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button and nav-link labels. Uppercase, 3 words max.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Text wordmark when the logo image is not used. Weight 400 minimum (300 is too thin below 24px).

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Resting card.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Card, default.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Raised card on hover or focus-within.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialog panel.
